This excessive multiple is entirely unsupported by the company's long-term fundamental performance, as demonstrated by a miserable compounded profit growth rate of -13% over 10 years, -30% over 5 years, and -63% over 3 years [E18, E19, E20]. Furthermore, the business is shrinking on the top line, having delivered poor sales growth of -11.1% over the past five years [E52]. Investors receive zero compensation for taking on these fundamental risks, as evidenced by a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4]. Compounding these operational distress signals, the company generates a deeply negative return on assets of -3.53%, contrasting sharply with the sector benchmark of 1.8% [E8]. Conceded: the company has managed a short-term bounce with 108% profit growth over the trailing twelve months and trades at a price-to-book ratio of 0.36x [E2, E21].
